title: No unnamed null values
description: No sample of a curve other than the index equals -999.25, -999 or -9999 unless that value is the header NULL (-999.25 is the NULL the CWLS LAS 2.0 standard shows). A data row fails once; its example is the first such sample in ~Curve order.

words.template: {count} rows hold a common null value the header does not name as NULL, the first at {first}.
